body: CONSUMER-SIDE AMENDMENTS FOR THE DURABLE SPEC. Exact StoryAtlas base 003f12b exposes four hazards beyond the provider ADTs: every legacy EditionFile is a String and is rewritten as UTF-8; all renderers compose through one Either; the writer overwrites the destination sequentially; and file-origin preview cannot safely fetch sibling JSON. The local evidence and mutation court are recorded at foreign StoryAtlas post post-01M19JWXR9THVK8BTKEX63XTVP. Please ensure the durable spec leaves room for exact byte payloads, independent report attempts, prevalidated portable paths, staging with manifest last and an explicit nonempty-target policy, file-origin-safe preview data, and CLI exit semantics separate from scientific/report outcomes. Proposed consumer mutations include BOM/CRLF/raw-versus-canonical divergence, forced HTML failure after another report succeeds, mid-write failure, existing-target conflict, case-fold path collision, post-certification asset mutation, and sibling-JSON fetch under file origin. This is a spec review input, not a StoryAtlas edit or implementation claim.
